affectedPublicSurfaces: api.app-juli.com GET /v1/demo/runs/{id}/events — gains a replay-seeded run kind, served by the SAME handler with the same SSE protocol, replay and Last-Event-ID semantics as a live run
committed scenario fixture files — they ship in the release artifact and are read at runtime, so a missing file is a runtime failure, not a build failure

candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: demo tenant only — replay runs never touch a real seller's shop

journeys.name: capture-produces-a-valid-sanitized-scenario
journeys.entryUrl: tool: capture against a real persisted workflow_run
assertions: output validates against the shared event union in packages/contracts
zero raw vendor identifiers and zero credentials, asserted by SCANNING the output rather than by reading it
no shop or product id that identifies a real merchant survives
re-running capture on the same run is byte-identical apart from captured_at

journeys.name: replay-streams-through-the-real-handler
journeys.entryUrl: candidate port: start a replay run, stream to a terminal event
assertions: the test asserts the REAL /v1/demo/runs/{id}/events handler served it, not that the bytes look plausible
an in-memory shortcut fails this journey — that shortcut is the defect this slice exists to prevent
the stream reaches a terminal event

journeys.name: reconnect-is-gapless-and-duplicate-free
journeys.entryUrl: candidate port: one mid-stream reconnect with Last-Event-ID
assertions: no event is skipped and none is delivered twice
sequence semantics are identical to a live run, not a replay-only variant

journeys.name: a-decision-appends-only-the-chosen-continuation
journeys.entryUrl: answer a decision request on a replay run
assertions: the chosen option's continuation is appended
an unknown option id is refused rather than ignored

journeys.name: pacing-and-dates-come-from-the-run-not-the-capture-day
assertions: recorded inter-event deltas are preserved within tolerance
timestamps are rebased to now — nothing renders a date from the capture day

journeys.name: a-stale-prompt-is-detectable-by-a-command
assertions: a scenario whose prompt_sha256 differs from the current production prompt is reported
the command is documented, so staleness is detectable rather than silent

htmlRoutes: not-applicable: API and fixture files, no HTML route

migrationCompatibility.notes: No migration. Replay runs seed ordinary workflow_run_events rows for a real workflow_run id, using columns that already exist. Stable and candidate read the same tables.

rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: redeploy the prior release. Replay runs are ordinary rows: assert a rollback leaves them readable and does not strand a run mid-stream.

acceptanceCommands: PYTHONPATH=$PWD/backend/src python -m pytest tests/integration -k 'replay or streaming' -q
PYTHONPATH=$PWD/backend/src python -m pytest tests -m 'not live and not demo_contract' -q
doNotInfer: Do not hand-author scenario event JSON. The issue is explicit: if the tool cannot produce it, fix the tool. A second hand-maintained source drifts from the first and both suites stay green — the same reason the localStorage mock is being deleted.

Do not assert that the streamed bytes look right. Assert that the REAL /v1/demo/runs/{id}/events handler served them. An in-memory shortcut is the specific defect this slice exists to prevent, and it will pass a bytes-only assertion.
Do not invent a scenario event shape. Every event validates against the shared event union in packages/contracts; a scenario that does not validate must fail CI.
Do not give replay runs their own sequence or Last-Event-ID semantics. They must use the live path's, or the reconnect test proves nothing about live behaviour.
Do not sanitize by inspection. Zero vendor identifiers and zero credentials is asserted by scanning output, because inspection does not scale to a fixture regenerated later.
Do not add a test module that calls alembic downgrade(..., 'base') without adding it to _DESTRUCTIVE_MIGRATION_MODULES in tests/conftest.py (#1405) — the guard test will fail, and correctly.

Do not build a registry by hand for agent tests. composition.py::build_product_tool_registry is the production builder; ADR-088 resolves terminal_tools against whichever registry is passed, and omitting them raises UnknownToolError at runtime (run ffc8fd40).
